title: Going Against the Current
next_chapter_hook: In the time-space rift, that vague figure gradually solidified, a pair of eyes filled with ten thousand years of vicissitudes piercing through illusion—Chen Tianming?! No, it was merely a fragment of consciousness, yet carrying a dying message sufficient to overturn Chen Ji's entire understanding.

text.content: The roar that shattered the heavens exploded within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, like a beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years finally opening its eyes. The body of the Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple trembled violently, golden blood seeping from his seven apertures—that was the price of the Tianji Record forcibly resonating with his soul. Pain, bone-deep pain, as if ten thousand dull blades simultaneously carved into his soul. Yet Chen Ji's lips slowly curved into a nearly mad smile. Pain? What is this pain compared to the despair of that senior from ten thousand years ago?

Chen Ji sat cross-legged in the void transformed by the residual soul of Mo Xiansheng on the first page of the Tianji Record. Spiritual Energy surged around him like a tide. He closed his eyes, and the Tianji Mark dormant at his Brow Center suddenly blazed, emanating a mysterious aura befitting no ordinary realm. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his Mental Sea: 'Are you certain you wish to walk this path? Previewing fate is the highest-level ability of the Tianji Record, and the most dangerous—it will consume a price beyond imagination.' Chen Ji offered no answer, merely thinking in his heart: I, Chen Ji, am never a chess piece of fate.

dialogue.content: Since that is the case, this old man shall open the gate of preview for you. But remember, every path you see in the preview carries a real price. What you choose will become what you must bear.

text.content: In an instant, Chen Ji felt his consciousness torn from his body, falling into a chaotic Void. There was no distinction between heaven and earth, no difference in time—only countless golden threads interwoven in the Void, binding fate and karma. He saw three most brilliant main threads, like three rushing rivers bearing entirely different endings. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more: 'These are the three paths destined in your fate. After seeing them, you will understand what it means when heaven's will is hard to defy.'

The first river flowed gently, its waters a gentle gold. Chen Ji gazed along it and saw a path called 'Destined to Rule by Heaven.' On that path, Chen Ji saw himself—no, the perfect Chen Ji chosen by the Tianji Record. He led humanity in repelling the Demonic Path, unifying the cultivation world, becoming an emperor for ten thousand ages. His name was carved into the Heaven's Will Monument, celebrated through eternity. However, when Chen Ji tried to see what price he paid, his pupils constricted sharply—that 'Chen Ji' had no one beside him. Su Qingyao blocked a lethal strike for him, her soul scattered to nothing; Ye Qing was sealed by his own hands, eternally imprisoned in the netherworld; even his sister Chen Nian became the sacrifice for his ascent.

Chen Ji spun around abruptly, daring not to look further. His heart hammered violently; those images seared into his Mental Sea like branding irons. The price of the first path was not his own life, but the lives of everyone he cared about. What kind of destiny is this? This was an outcome Chen Ji would rather be struck by lightning than accept!

The second river appeared blood-red, its waves surging with world-destroying ferocity. This path was called 'Defying Heaven to Change Fate.' Chen Ji saw himself stepping over countless bones, wielding a pitch-black sword, crushing the three great Sects one by one. Ling Yuan's head was displayed at the city gate; Han Lie's Dantian was shattered by a single palm; even the高高在上的天道之眼 was pierced through its brow by his sword. However, the price was equally shocking—Chen Ji saw his own hollow gaze; he had become a demon, his heart empty of everything but hatred. On this path, he would become a monster more terrifying than the Heaven's Eye.

Chen Ji smiled bitterly. The second path seemed satisfying on the surface, but it would completely dehumanize him. He could imagine such an ending—when hatred devours everything, what meaning would his existence have? That was not breaking the chess game; that was making himself the most pitiful piece upon the board. Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted up幽幽: 'The third path is mutual destruction with the Heaven's Eye. You die, it perishes, the Tianji Record completely dissipates from the world. Humanity, Demonic Path, demon race—all lose the possibility of another prophet emerging for a thousand years. This is mutual annihilation.'

Three paths, three endings, each demanding an unbearable price. Chen Ji stood at this crossroads of fate and suddenly burst into laughter. That laughter echoed through the Void, carrying traces of madness and defiance. Ten thousand years? What a fine ten thousand years! The senior from ten thousand years ago could not escape this predicament—why should Chen Ji accept his fate? Mo Xiansheng seemed to sense something, and after a long silence spoke again: 'What are you laughing at?' Chen Ji wiped the bloody tears from the corners of his eyes, his eyes blazing with brilliance: 'I am laughing—does the Tianji Record offer three paths, so I can only walk three paths?'

At this very moment, a fourth ray of light appeared in the Void. It was neither golden threads nor a blood-red river, but a cluster of hazy mist, so blurred it was nearly impossible to discern. Chen Ji stared fixedly at that mist, his heart nearly stopping. Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled: 'Impossible... This is... a fourth path? This old man has followed the Tianji Record's masters through generations, yet never once has a fourth possibility appeared!' Chen Ji extended a hand, attempting to touch that mist, but found only void. The price? What was the price of this path? Mo Xiansheng could not answer, for in the Tianji Record's rules, this item simply did not exist.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji gazed at that blurred fourth possibility, his Mental Sea torn by inner conflict. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried rare solemnity: 'The preview ends here; you must make your choice.'

choices.description: Even though the Tianji Record never recorded it, even though the price was entirely unknown, Chen Ji would forge his own path. The regret of that senior from ten thousand years ago must never be repeated in this life.
choices.visible_cost: Unknown price, possibly more brutal than the first three paths
choices.visible_reward: Breaking through the Tianji Record's preset chess game to find true freedom
choices.risk_hint: This is a path no one has ever walked; the price of failure may be complete annihilation

text.content: Chen Ji's answer was crisp and decisive: 'I will walk the fourth path.' The moment his words fell, that cluster of hazy mist trembled violently, as if responding to his resolve. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while before finally sighing: 'Very well. Since your resolve is set, this old man will accompany you in this madness.' The Tianji Record's light abruptly dimmed, and Chen Ji's consciousness began returning to his body. However, just as this happened, a voice suddenly came from deep within the mist—that voice was aged and familiar, carrying the weariness and defiance of ten thousand years.

choices.description: Although the three paths were cruel, they were at least certain. Chen Ji decided to choose the first path of heavenly destiny, the one with the relatively smallest price, to survive first.
choices.visible_reward: Becoming an emperor for ten thousand ages, renowned throughout history
choices.risk_hint: This path seems perfect but is in truth the most merciless—you will forever lose your qualification to be human

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, his gaze had regained its usual calm. 'The first path.' he said slowly. Mo Xiansheng seemed to have anticipated this, offering no further words, merely projecting a mysterious rune into the Void. That rune entered Chen Ji's Brow Center, bringing waves of stinging pain. However, at this very moment, Chen Ji suddenly felt a strong sense of unease—the path he chose seemed to have something wrong about it.

choices.description: Chen Ji decided not to rush into a decision, exiting the preview state. He needed more time to think, and needed to confirm what exactly that fourth path was.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the optimal timing may lead to a more passive chess game later
choices.visible_reward: Preserving all possibilities, time to gather more information
choices.risk_hint: Fate will not wait forever; delay may lead to unpredictable consequences

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his extended hand and stepped back slowly. 'Let me think about it.' he said. Mo Xiansheng did not seem surprised, nodding: 'As you wish. Such an important matter does indeed require careful consideration.' The Tianji Record's light began to fade, Chen Ji's consciousness gradually returning to reality. However, just as he was about to leave this Void, that cluster of hazy mist suddenly surged violently, and a blurred figure slowly emerged from within—though its features were indistinct, a familiar aura rushed to greet him.

That figure flickered in and out of visibility in the mist, like an old painting eroded by ten thousand years. Chen Ji could not see his face clearly, yet he could feel a tremor of bloodline connection. Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly rose in pitch, carrying unimaginable shock: 'This aura... Impossible! Chen Tianming?! Weren't you supposed to have fallen ten thousand years ago? Why would you leave a consciousness fragment within this fourth path?!' The blurred figure seemed to hear Mo Xiansheng's cry, slowly turning its head. A pair of eyes filled with ten thousand years of vicissitudes pierced through illusion, gazing directly at Chen Ji—at this descendant separated from him by ten thousand years. Its lips moved, producing断续断续的声音, yet every word struck the soul: 'Descendant... Tianji Record... is not prophecy... it is... a shackle... break it... to truly...' Before the words finished, the figure flickered like a dying candle, about to dissolve into nothing.

Chen Ji lunged forward, his hands passing through that blurred figure yet catching nothing. Though the voice was faint, it was like a thunderclap splitting his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record was a shackle? How could this be? He had always believed the Tianji Record was a tool to change fate, a key to breaking the chess game, yet had never considered—it was itself part of the chess game! Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled as well: 'Chen Tianming... the master of the Tianji Record from ten thousand years ago... he actually left a consciousness fragment within this fourth path... this old man has followed masters through generations, yet no one has ever triggered this hidden ninth pattern line...'

choice.prompt: The figure about to dissolve seemed to have more to say; Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: Chen Ji burned his own Heavenly Fate Value, attempting to use the Tianji Record's power to fix that consciousness fragment in the Void. Regardless of the price, he must hear Chen Tianming's dying words.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the key information fragment left by Chen Tianming
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value drops to a dangerous threshold, possibly triggering the Tianji Record's forced dormancy mechanism

text.id: 天机录_ch0861_result_强行留住意识碎片_001
text.content: A sharp determination flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. His hands rapidly formed seals, the Tianji Mark at his Brow Center blazed frantically. He poured his Heavenly Fate Value into that dissolving figure, each point burning like his very lifespan. Mo Xiansheng cried out: 'You're mad! This way you will—' Before he could finish, that figure was indeed temporarily fixed in place. Chen Tianming's aged eyes looked at Chen Ji, the corners of his mouth even pulling into a hint of a smile: 'Good... descendant... you have courage... listen to me... the Tianji Record... ninth page... contains...'

text.id: 天机录_ch0861_result_用天机录复制信息_001
text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his hands forming seals rapidly. The pages of the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea rustled turned, stopping on a blank page. A faint light shot from his Brow Center, slowly imprinting Chen Tianming's figure and words. However, that figure dissolved far faster than he imagined—in the end, only half a sentence and a blurred outline remained. Chen Tianming's voice came断续: 'Tianji Record... ninth page... not in... the book... within... your heart... find it... to break... ten thousand years of...' The voice cut off abruptly; the figure dissolved completely, leaving only a blurred outline imprinted on the Tianji Record's page.

choices.description: Chen Ji chose not to interfere, letting Chen Tianming's consciousness dissipate naturally. He believed that since this fourth path had already appeared, the truth would eventually come to light. Excessive force might only backfire.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the chance to obtain first-hand information
choices.visible_reward: Avoid consuming Heavenly Fate Value, maintain current state
choices.risk_hint: This may be the only chance to contact Chen Tianming; missing it may mean there will never be another

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hands and watched quietly as that figure flickered in the mist. Chen Tianming seemed to sense something; a hint of approval flickered in those aged eyes. You did right... Chen Tianming's voice grew fainter, 'forcing... will only make you... repeat my fate... remember... the answer is not in... the Tianji Record... it is within you...' Before the words finished, the figure dissolved like morning mist into nothing. However, in that instant of dissolution, Chen Tianming's residual consciousness transformed into a point of light, entering Chen Ji's Brow Center and bringing a scene that made his entire body tremble—a ninth page of the Tianji Record he had never seen before, containing only four characters, yet seemingly holding the supreme principle to reverse heaven and earth: 'My fate is determined by myself.'

Chen Ji's consciousness slowly returned from the Void to his body. He opened his eyes to find himself still seated cross-legged before the Tianji Record, everything around him as before. Yet his gaze was entirely different from moments ago—that was a depth and tranquility born from seeing through certain truths. Mo Xiansheng's voice arose in his Mental Sea, carrying traces of melancholy: 'Chen Tianming... that master from ten thousand years ago... he too once tried to break the shackles of fate. Unfortunately, he failed, ultimately meeting an ending of body destroyed and Dao lost.' Chen Ji did not answer, merely lowering his gaze to his own hands. There, something seemed to be awakening—that was the power of the Tianji Record's ninth page, the ultimate mystery Chen Tianming could never reach even unto death. 'My fate is determined by myself...' he murmured, repeating these four characters, a meaningful smile slowly curling his lips.

At this moment, the pages of the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently. Mo Xiansheng cried out: 'Bad! The sealed portion of memory... impacted by the fourth path you just triggered... is unsealing!' Chen Ji felt a flood of unfamiliar images pouring into his mind—the cultivation world of ten thousand years ago, Chen Tianming in his vigorous youth, his trajectory of gradually approaching the truth, and the moment of his ultimate failure. However, these images were too fragmented to piece together into complete information. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried traces of懊恼: 'It seems the Tianji Record's rules do not permit early revelation of too much truth... but at least you now know—the fourth path truly exists, and its key lies within your own heart.'

Chen Ji rose slowly to his feet, feeling the Heavenly Fate power flowing through his body. Although he made different choices, all roads lead to the same destination—whether forcibly preserving the consciousness fragment, using the Tianji Record to copy information, or letting it dissipate naturally, he obtained key information from Chen Tianming: the key to the fourth path lies in the four characters 'My fate is determined by myself.' The Tianji Record's ninth page is not in the book but in the heart. What did this mean? It meant what he needed to break was not only the heavens' chess game but also his own dependence on the Tianji Record! Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter echoing through the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, startling a flock of birds into flight. Ten thousand years, you have treated the Chen family's descendants as chess pieces? Fine, then I will overturn this chessboard!
